_readme: Hand-labeled eval set for lib/scoring/classify.ts. Ids only: message text stays in Supabase, not git. Exec board members' messages are left out (and replaced if someone joins the exec board) because they're never scored. Run: npm run eval:classifier Shipped labels are 'shipped_candidate' (the model only flags; an exec approves).
